name: codewarden-secrets
description: Get CodeWarden secrets in a GitHub Actions job with the job's own OIDC token (design §32.21).

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts src/post.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outdir=dist --out-extension:.js=.js --legal-comments=eof "--banner:js=import { createRequire as __cwCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cwCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
